name: clinica-oasis-to-bids
description:
OASIS to BIDS converter.

Convert the imaging and clinical data of OASIS (https://sites.wustl.edu/oasisbrains/),
located in DATASET_DIRECTORY and CLINICAL_DATA_DIRECTORY respectively,
to a BIDS dataset in the target BIDS_DIRECTORY.

inputs.description: Path to a text file containing a list of specific subjects to extract.The expected format is one subject ID per line.
inputs.name: subjects_list

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs
